CONTROLS.NAME: bright
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a bright pulse through the scene (inverted if invert is on).

CONTROLS.NAME: dark
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a dark pulse through the scene (inverted if invert is on).

CONTROLS.NAME: hue
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change the hue of the entire scene.

CONTROLS.NAME: levels
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Reduces the color space, resulting in less saturated colors and more abstract shapes. 100% is all colors, 0% is only 2 or 3.

CONTROLS.NAME: fire
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Amount of 'fire', or glow leaking up from the bottom.

CONTROLS.NAME: invert
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Change all colors to their opposite colors. Makes the scene much brighter.

CONTROLS.NAME: feedback
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Feedback, or 'upward fading'. 0% is no blurring with very crisp lines. 100% will be no action, just upward scrolling.

CONTROLS.NAME: sun_pierce
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: On press, a sun-like orb appears in the center, and echoes through the scene.

CONTROLS.NAME: stutter
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Low frame rate is responsible for a lot of the dramatic visual patterns in this scene. Make it stutter even more (lower frame rate) by moving this slider up. Or make it smoother and less dramatic by moving this down.

CONTROLS.NAME: auto_reset
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Reset the feedback by flashing 'mountains' on bass hits.

CONTROLS.NAME: manual_reset
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Manually reset the feedback by flashing to the 'mountains' screen.
